data.title: Iwa Robotics Unveils HAWK, CANARY and PELICAN: An Autonomous Drone Fleet Equipped to Detect, Diagnose, and Suppress Urban Wildfires
data.description: Robotics company pairs long-range detection, real-time fire diagnostics, and precision aerial suppression into a single dispatchable system — operated by fire departments as an autonomous aerial fleet.
data.author: Iwa Robotics
